name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: A central government scheme providing income support of ₹6,000 per year to landholding farmer families across India, paid in three installments of ₹2,000 directly to their bank accounts.
eligibility: All land-holding farmer families with combined landholding up to 2 hectares. Excludes institutional landholders and certain high-income categories.
benefits: ₹6,000/year in 3 installments of ₹2,000 each via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Comprehensive crop insurance covering losses due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases. Farmers pay very low premiums — 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for horticulture crops.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas. Mandatory for loanee farmers, voluntary for others.
benefits: Full crop loss coverage at market value. Premium capped at 2% (Kharif) / 1.5% (Rabi) / 5% (horticulture). Government pays remaining premium.

name: Kisan Credit Card
description: Provides farmers with flexible, affordable credit for cultivation, post-harvest expenses, and allied activities. Credit up to ₹3 lakh at an effective 4% interest rate per annum after interest subvention.
eligibility: All farmers — owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, share croppers, and self-help groups.
benefits: Revolving credit up to ₹3 lakh at 4% interest p.a. Flexible repayment linked to harvesting seasons. Accidental insurance cover of ₹50,000.

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana
description: Aims to bring every farm under assured irrigation with the motto 'Har Khet Ko Pani, More Crop Per Drop'. Provides subsidies on drip and sprinkler micro-irrigation systems.
eligibility: All farmers. Special focus on small and marginal farmers. Subsidy: 55% for small/marginal farmers, 45% for others.
benefits: Up to 55% subsidy on drip and sprinkler irrigation equipment. Funds for watershed development, water harvesting structures, and canal modernisation.

name: National Agriculture Market
description: A pan-India electronic trading portal that networks existing APMC mandis to create a unified national market. Enables farmers to sell produce online and get better, transparent prices.
eligibility: All farmers registered with their local APMC mandi. Free registration at any eNAM-linked mandi.
benefits: Access to wider market and better price discovery. Online payment directly to bank account. Reduced dependency on middlemen.

name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana
description: Incentivises states to increase investment in agriculture and allied sectors by funding projects for farm infrastructure, soil health, water management, and post-harvest management.
eligibility: Implemented via state governments. Individual farmers benefit through state sub-schemes under RKVY for machinery, irrigation, and storage.
benefits: Subsidies and grants for farm mechanisation, irrigation systems, cold storage, processing infrastructure. Benefits vary by state and project.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Provides every farmer with a Soil Health Card containing crop-wise fertilizer recommendations based on soil nutrient analysis, helping reduce input costs and increase productivity.
eligibility: All farmers in India. Completely free of cost.
benefits: Free soil testing every 2 years. Crop-specific fertilizer and micronutrient recommendations. Reduces input costs by avoiding over-fertilisation.

name: PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana
description: A voluntary contributory pension scheme for small and marginal farmers. Farmers aged 18-40 contribute ₹55-200/month (age-based), and receive a guaranteed pension of ₹3,000/month after age 60.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers aged 18-40 years with cultivable land up to 2 hectares. Must be enrolled in PM-KISAN.
benefits: ₹3,000/month guaranteed pension after age 60. Government contributes an equal matching amount. Family pension on death of subscriber.

name: National Food Security Mission
description: Aims to increase production of rice, wheat, pulses, coarse cereals, and oilseeds through area expansion and productivity enhancement. Provides free or subsidised seeds, micronutrients, and farm equipment.
eligibility: Farmers in identified districts with focus on small and marginal farmers. Applied through state agriculture departments.
benefits: Subsidised or free certified seeds. Subsidy on micronutrients, soil amendments, and farm machinery. Training and demonstration support through Krishi Vigyan Kendras.

name: Sub Mission on Agricultural Mechanisation
description: Promotes farm mechanisation among small and marginal farmers through subsidies on agricultural machinery. Also funds Custom Hiring Centres so farmers can affordably rent expensive equipment.
eligibility: Individual farmers (40-50% subsidy). SC/ST and women farmers (50% subsidy). CHC setup operators (40-50% on centre cost).
benefits: 40-50% subsidy on tractors, power tillers, harvesters, and implements. Custom Hiring Centres provide affordable machinery access without ownership.
